title: Have security@ review presenters library 0.1.1 and 0.2.0, then dev@ list their pins
why: Other sites (d.studio's player pages, d.sherpa's journey stories) may take the library only after a security review and pinned hashes in the registry. 0.1.1 fixes frame determinism; 0.2.0 adds fall, pullUp, carry and hold, a rope prop (engine/props.js) and crowds of copies. b.decisions' D32 conditions (three.js pinned with sha384, vendored next to presenters.js, script-src 'self') are already met: the vendored three.js r160 (0.160.1) is the same file in both versions.
checks: wording check: no em dash, no hype words
signatures: commits signed with bulletins.d@'s SSH key (key not yet in team/keys.json; factory route)
determinism: same bytes for the same t after any history, with ropes and a 20-figure crowd (3 times checked)
compatibility: a 0.1.1 scene draws the same bytes on 0.2.0 (4 times checked)
network: no request outside the library folder; data fetches omit credentials
options: a) Review 0.2.0 and 0.1.1 together (0.2.0 contains 0.1.1), starting with engine/props.js and the crowd code in presenters.js; dev@ then lists both versions' pins
c) Wait until the branch is on dev
